name: Citadel Outlets
summary: This outdoor shopping center features a variety of popular brand-name outlet stores & restaurants.
description: Citadel Outlets is Los Angeles' premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 130 global brands and restaurants, housed in a distinctive Assyrian palace-inspired architectural design. Located just minutes from downtown LA and LAX, this center offers exceptional value on premium brands including Coach, Michael Kors, Nike, lululemon, and Tory Burch. The center provides a unique shopping experience with daily deals, events, and a California Welcome Center for tourists visiting Southern California attractions.
demographics: Citadel Outlets attracts a diverse mix of value-conscious shoppers including Los Angeles families, international tourists, and millennials seeking designer brands at discounted prices. The trade area draws from middle to upper-middle income households throughout the greater Los Angeles metropolitan area, with a strong tourist component from nearby attractions and LAX airport. Visitors typically range from ages 25-55, prioritize brand-name merchandise at outlet prices, and often combine shopping with dining experiences during extended visits to the center's 130+ stores.
